page.layout: One printed page with running text in a single column, centred right of the gutter; page number and running head at the top; catchword "pro-" at the foot right. Right edge shows show-through and a neighbouring page edge, not transcribed.

main_text.p: anhelat, ubi pro Veritate stamus despumare & effutire? & sublati clamoribus somnum illum ab rumpere, quo maxima pars hominum, quæ doctum nomen habet, tam altum indormiscit: quo vetustatis scrupulosa mysteria confopiunt, quos absorbent captiosæ vocum minutiæ, quibus unius Scriptoris sensum omnem sepelivit authoritas, quos superstitio fascinat, quos ut pueros à Veritatis tramite deterrent Mandu-cus &Lemures. Accedit,maximam partem auditorum, qui disputationes nostras avidè circumstant, vulgarem esse, & obtusam, nec quò per argutias subtiliter tendimus, comitari valentem: hi proinde certamina nostra ex ingenio suo metiuntur : apud hos detectam Veritatem,quæ paribus utrimque studiis inquirebatur, agnovisse pro-

page.notes: Right margin carries faint show-through and cropped marginal notes from the facing page, not legible enough to transcribe. Words such as "sublati" and "sepelivit" are printed with long s; rendered as plain s per rules. The line "agnovisse" is read as printed.
